name: Untameable : A Red-Haired Shanks Otome Game
source:
In this game, you'll navigate through [b]four different routes[/b], each one exploring a unique relationship dynamic with Shanks. From camaraderie to rivalry, from platonic bonds to romantic connections, each route offers a different perspective on Shanks and his interactions with other characters.

[From [url=https://opshankszine.itch.io/untameable-shanks-otome-game]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你将穿越[b]四种不同的路线[/b]，每条路线都探索与香克斯的独特关系动态。从友情到竞争，从柏拉图式的纽带到浪漫的联系，每条路线都为香克斯以及他与其他角色的互动提供了不同的视角。

[来自[url=https://opshankszine.itch.io/untameable-shanks-otome-game]Itch.io[/url]]
